Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R21-24
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O21-751
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR’S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 – 14)
1.
CITY COUNCIL ACTION MINUTES
a.
June 8, 2021 Special Budget Workshop Minutes
b.
June 8, 2021 Regular Meeting Minutes
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
2.
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTERS
Recommendation:   Review and Approve Warrant Registers.
3.
PLANNING COMMISSION ACTIONS OF JUNE 15, 2021
Recommendation: Receive and File.
4.
PROVISION OF FINANCIAL INFORMATION TO THE CITY COUNCIL IN ACCORDANCE WITH STATE GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 41004 AND CITY MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 2.10.020(E)
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council: Receive and file financial statements for the Month of May 2021.
5.
REVISED PALOS VERDES PENINSULA ENHANCED WATERSHED MANAGEMENT PROGRAM (EWMP) AND REASONABLE ASSURANCE ANALYSIS (RAA) FOR SUBMITTAL TO THE LOS ANGELES REGIONAL WATER QUALITY CONTROL BOARD
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the revised Palos Verdes Peninsula Enhanced Watershed Management Program which shall be submitted to the Los Angeles Regional Water Quality Control Board (Regional Board) by the regulatory deadline of June 30, 2021.
6.
ADOPTION OF PROPOSED RESOLUTION R21-24 APPROVING THE ACCEPTANCE OF AMERICAN RESCUE PLAN ACT FUNDING IN THE AGGREGATE AMOUNT OF $3,175,184
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council adopt proposed Resolution R21-24 which approves the acceptance of American Rescue Plan Act funding from the United States Federal Government in the estimated aggregate amount of $3,175,184.
7.
APPROVAL OF A ONE-YEAR CONTRACT WITH THE BLACK KNIGHT PATROL, LLC FOR TRAFFIC CONTROL SERVICES FOR AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $50,000.00
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve a one-year contract with Black Knight Patrol, LLC for traffic control services from July 1, 2021 to June 30, 2022 for an amount not to exceed $50,000.
8.
PALOS VERDES BEACH AND ATHLETIC CLUB FY 2021-22 OPERATING AND CAPITAL BUDGET
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council review and approve the Palos Verdes Beach and Athletic Club (PVBAC) Foundation’s Operating and Capital Budget for Fiscal Year 2021/22.
9.
RECEIPT AND FILING OF THE MONTHLY INVESTMENT TRANSACTION REPORTS FOR THE MONTH ENDING MAY 31, 2021
Recommendation: The City Treasurer recommends the City Council receive and file the Monthly Investment Transaction Report for the month ending May 31, 2021.
10.
EXTENSION OF CITY HALL/ POLICE DEPARTMENT JANITORIAL SERVICES CONTRACT WITH ALL CARE INDUSTRIES INC. FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021/22
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the contract extension with All Care Industries Inc. for City Hall/Police Department janitorial services for Fiscal Year 2021/22.
11.
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION R21-25 AUTHORIZING THE APPROVAL OF “FY 2021-2022 ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2017 (SENATE BILL 1)” PROPOSED PROJECT LIST
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt proposed Resolution R21-25 approving the “2021-2022 Road Repair and Accountability Act of 2017 (Senate Bill 1)” Proposed Project List for the City of Palos Verdes Estates and authorizing the City’s Public Works Director to submit the Project List and supporting documentation to the California Transportation Commission (CTC) by July 1, 2021.
12.
APPROVAL OF SPECIAL EVENT APPLICATION SUBMITTED BY THE MALAGA COVE BUSINESS AND PROFESSIONAL ASSOCIATION FOR “MALAGA COVE CONCERTS IN THE PARK” AT FARNHAM MARTIN PARK ON WEDNESDAY, JULY 14 & 28 AND AUGUST 11 & 25
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve the Special Event Application submitted by the Malaga Cove Business and Professional Association for the 2021“Malaga Cove Concerts in the Park” at Farnham Martin Park on Wednesdays, July 14th, July 28th, August 11th, and August 25th, 2021.
13.
ADOPTION OF PROPOSED RESOLUTION R21-26 ESTABLISHING THE APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT AT $31,363,524 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021/2022
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council adopt proposed resolution R21-26 establishing the Appropriations Limit for the City of Palos Verdes Estates for Fiscal Year 2021/2022 at $31,363,524.
14.
TEMPORARY EXTENSION OF AGREEMENT WITH STAY GREEN, INC. FOR CITYWIDE LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE SERVICES TO SEPTEMBER 30, 2021
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council temporarily extend the current one-year agreement with Stay Green, Inc. for citywide landscape maintenance services until September 30, 2021.
PUBLIC HEARING(S)/ORDINANCES
OLD BUSINESS
15.
ADOPTION OF PROPOSED RESOLUTION R21-27 APPROVING AND ADOPTING THE CITY COUNCIL ADOPTED BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021/2022
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council adopt proposed resolution R21-27 approving and adopting the City Council Adopted Budget for Fiscal Year 2021/2022.
16.
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION R21-28 APPROVING A POLICY FOR REMOVAL OF UNAUTHORIZED ENCROACHMENTS AND RESOLUTION R-21-29 ESTABLISHING ADMINISTRATIVE FINES FOR VIOLATIONS
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council:
A.
Approve Resolution No. R21-28 consolidating and updating existing Resolutions R05-32, R12-05, & R14-18;
B.
Approve the abatement prioritization described under “2) Abatement Prioritization” of this staff report;
C.
Approve Resolution No. R21-29 establishing administrative fines specifically for violations of PVEMC Chapter 12.04;
D.
Direct Planning Commission to consider recommending right-of-way vacation in Miscellaneous Application review; and
E.
Direct staff to commence the education campaign described under “5) Education Campaign” of this staff report.
NEW BUSINESS
17.
EXTENSION OF MUNICIPAL SEPARATE STORM SEWER SYSTEM PERMIT (MS4) CONSULTING AGREEMENT WITH MCGOWAN CONSULTING, LLC FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021/22
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the contract extension with McGowan Consulting, LLC for Municipal Separate Storm Sewer Permit (MS 4) consulting services for Fiscal Year 2021/22. MAYOR AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, report on community activities and ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, June 22, 2021 AT 6:30 P.M.
i.
This City Council meeting can be viewed on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org.

Carol Cowley, Interim City Clerk
